Name: Robin Sells More
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
Adds more things for Robin (The Carpenter) to sell in her store.

This mod aims to greatly improve the items sold at Robin's Carpentry Shop, Most items can be bought in the early stages of the game with little to no money.

This mod will be worked on adding more things for her to sell, i ask that if you guys would like me to add more things for Robin to sell just say them in the discussions tab and I'll be sure to add them in the next update.

It is important to note that Robin gives a discount based on friendship points - 500 FP - 10% off, 1000 FP - 25% off, 2000 FP - 50% off, So prices will vary in-game.

v1.0 - Robin Sells; Chest - 30g, Hardwood - 80g, Clay - 40g, Preserves Jar - 500g, Keg - 625g, Bee House - 600g, Tapper - 300g, Cask - 500g, Hyper Speed-Gro - 200g, and fiannly, Tree Fertilizer - 300g.
